mechanism.base: Earth tames water, the old texts say. The solid wins over the empty, and the bank decides where the river goes. Water on its own spreads thin and finds every low place. Held by ground, it gathers into a channel deep enough to carry boats and turn a mill. The river keeps all its force against the bank and comes away with a direction, while the ground gains a field that drinks.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: You carry little Water. The ground has banks and no river between them, and plans stay drawn while fields go dry. Start one thing this month and let it run.
mechanism.friction_turn: More Water moves in you than the ground can hold. The river spreads wider than its banks, and the ground washes away under everything it chases. Keep one weekend free of anything new.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Water gives it a current, and you gain most on the move. As a catalyst, the current runs thin. You choose where it goes, and each gain you make is one you worked for.
function.definition_friction: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Water makes it pour and spread as it goes. As a friction, more pours through than you can settle. No gain ever feels like firm ground, and what comes your way is rarely enjoyed.
function.definition_balanced: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Water gives it a current, and you gain most on the move. In balance, the current moves at your pace. You go out and come back at a steady rhythm.
function.advise_catalyst: Your Action grows when it has somewhere to go and something to bring back. Put one plan into motion this season, a trip booked or a small venture opened with money you can spare. Follow one lead you heard about and see what it turns up.
function.advise_friction: Seek Earth, your own Body energy. Earth is the bank and the bed, the ground that keeps water to one course. Let it hold what Water pours. With this much flowing through, little of it ever feels truly yours. Finish one thing you started before you open anything new. Keep one evening a week at home with nothing planned.
function.advise_balanced: Your Action stays steady while what you go out for and what you bring home keep the same pace. Follow one lead you heard about and see what it turns up. Let one quiet morning a month pass with no plans at all.

candidates.cta_verdict: You get what you want by going around rather than through, and most of what you keep came to you while you were moving.

catalyst.clause: The ground has banks and no river between them
catalyst.remedy: Start one thing this month and let it run.

friction.clause: The river spreads wider than its banks
friction.remedy: Keep one weekend free of anything new.

wide.clause: There is no shortage of Water in you, the river already running where you stand.
wide.remedy: Use the current. Start the thing you keep describing.

missing.clause: The ground is dug and ready, and no spring rises to fill the well.
missing.remedy: Borrow the flow from a partner, a deadline, one small venture.

spared.clause: There is no Water in you, and the ground never washes out from under you.
spared.remedy: Leave it out. Keep to the ground you already have.

thin.clause: Water is a trickle in you, and the banks take it without strain.
thin.remedy: Keep it small. One open chance at a time.

excess.clause: Too much Water for the ground to bank, and what should water the field washes it away.
excess.remedy: Bank it. Finish one thing before you start another.

__ore.retired_bonds_dip: You hold people by being their banks: steady sides that let their current run.
__ore.retired_fn_body: The Drive is your action function: what you go get, build, and hold. With Water running it, action in you is hydraulic: you build channels, then let volume do the work. Income streams, standing arrangements, systems that flow while you sleep. You claim by routing rather than grabbing, and what you route well returns forever. Dig the canal once, drink for years.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Earth, and Earth tames Water: banks give the river its path. Water is the moving, liquid, flowing material your ground exists to channel: money, opportunity, people in motion. That is why Water is your Action, the arena of what you build and claim. You do not chase the river. You shape the banks and let it arrive.

backlog_dips_tg_pattern.order: The wealth you channel becomes structure: managed current turns into the aqueduct that orders the valley.

__ore.retired_v3_definition_catalyst:
Water is your Action, and as a catalyst, it is moving value passing through your steady hands: money, opportunities, people in motion who need somewhere reliable to land. You profit by being the stable point in a moving system.

The friend people route deals through, the account that quietly grows, the introductions that keep landing on your desk because you handle them well. Flow trusts you, and trust is the whole business.

Value moves toward whoever moves it cleanly. Keep a fixed monthly review of what flows through you, income, offers, introductions, and route each one deliberately. Answer the forwardable email same-day. Save a fixed share of every inflow first.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_friction:
Water is your Action, and as a friction, it is managing flows you no longer need to manage: accounts checked daily, opportunities tracked past usefulness, control spending the calm it was meant to protect.

Watchful, responsible, quietly leaking. The portfolio gets opened before breakfast, the tracked deals mostly expire tracked, and the steadiness everyone values in you is being spent refreshing dashboards nobody asked about.

A well-built channel does not need a warden. Automate the transfers and check monthly, on one fixed day. Archive whatever sat watched but untouched for ninety days. Let one week a quarter pass entirely unmonitored, and spend the attention on something that cannot be refreshed.
